labs.title: Manage Microsoft 365 Copilot agent inventory
labs.summary: Use the Microsoft 365 admin center Agents area to review a pending org-built agent, publish it only for Sales, block a risky third-party agent, and configure tenant agent settings.
labs.scenario: Contoso is enabling agents for a small Sales pilot. In the **simulated Microsoft 365 admin center**, use **Agents > All agents > Requests** to review a pending org-built agent, inspect its publisher, capabilities, knowledge sources, and permissions, then publish it only to **Copilot Pilot - Sales**. In the **Registry**, block a third-party agent that requests broad data access. In **Agents > Settings**, set controls so Microsoft and Contoso-built agents are allowed, external publisher agents are not allowed, and broad sharing is limited to approved makers. Do not deploy any agent tenant-wide.
learningObjectives: Review agent requests before publishing them to the organization catalog
Scope an approved agent to a specific Microsoft 365 group instead of everyone
Block an external agent that requests excessive data access
Configure organization-level agent and plugin access, sharing, and user access settings
Compare declarative agents, custom engine agents, Agent Builder, and Copilot Studio at an administrative level
prerequisites: Know what Microsoft 365 groups and Copilot agents are

steps.title: Review the pending Sales agent
steps.instruction: Open **Agents > All agents > Requests**, select **Sales Proposal Coach**, and review its publisher, capabilities, knowledge sources, permissions, and custom actions.
steps.hint: The details pane shows the publisher, knowledge sources, and permissions.
steps.explanation: Administrators review requested agents before publishing so they understand what data and tools an agent can use.

rules.description: Sales Proposal Coach request was opened

steps.title: Publish the agent only for Sales pilot users
steps.instruction: Select **Publish to store**. In the wizard, choose **Copilot Pilot - Sales**, keep **Preinstall for selected users** off, choose **Default template**, turn on **Accept requested permissions**, and select **Publish**.
steps.hint: Do not choose **All users** or **Sales department**.
steps.explanation: Publishing to a specific group makes the agent available only to that audience and avoids a tenant-wide rollout.

rules.description: Sales Proposal Coach is published only to Copilot Pilot - Sales
rules.failureFeedback: Publish Sales Proposal Coach to Copilot Pilot - Sales only.

steps.title: Block the risky third-party agent
steps.instruction: Open **All agents > Registry**, select **Vendor CRM Booster**, review the high-risk permissions, and select **Block agent**.
steps.hint: The risky agent is from an external publisher and asks for broad mailbox, SharePoint, and CRM access.
steps.explanation: Blocking an agent is appropriate when its publisher or requested access conflicts with policy.

rules.failureFeedback: Select Vendor CRM Booster and block it.

steps.title: Set allowed agent categories
steps.instruction: Open **Agents > Settings > Agent and plugin access**. Keep **Allow agents and plugins built by Microsoft** on, keep **Allow agents and plugins built by your organization** on, and turn **Allow agents and plugins built by external publishers** off.
steps.hint: The scenario permits Microsoft and Contoso-built agents while blocking external publisher agents.
steps.explanation: Allowed agent type settings control what users can view and install from the catalog by publisher category.

rules.description: External publishers are disabled while Microsoft and org-built agents are allowed
rules.failureFeedback: Allow Microsoft and Contoso-built agents, and turn off external publisher agents.

steps.title: Limit sharing and user access
steps.instruction: On **Sharing**, set **Who can share agents with the organization** to **Specific users** and choose **Agent Makers - Approved**. On **User access**, set **Who can access agents and plugins** to **Specific users or groups** and choose **Copilot Pilot - Sales**.
steps.hint: Sharing controls broad sharing by makers. User access controls who can use agents and plugins.
steps.explanation: Lifecycle governance separates who can create and share agents from who can use them.

rules.description: Sharing is limited to approved makers and user access to the pilot group
rules.failureFeedback: Scope sharing to Agent Makers - Approved and user access to Copilot Pilot - Sales.

steps.title: View agent usage
steps.instruction: Open **Reports > Usage > Agents** to review the current agent usage view.
steps.hint: Usage is optional for governance but useful after deployment.
steps.explanation: Usage and lifecycle signals help admins monitor adoption and risky agents.

labs.solution:
1. Open **Agents > All agents > Requests** and select **Sales Proposal Coach**. Review **Publisher**, **Capabilities**, **Knowledge sources**, **Permissions**, and **Custom actions**.
2. Select **Publish to store**. In the wizard choose **Copilot Pilot - Sales**, keep **Preinstall for selected users** off, choose **Default template**, turn on **Accept requested permissions**, and select **Publish**.
3. Open **Agents > All agents > Registry**, select **Vendor CRM Booster**, review the broad permissions, and select **Block agent**.
4. Open **Agents > Settings > Agent and plugin access**. Leave **Allow agents and plugins built by Microsoft** on, leave **Allow agents and plugins built by your organization** on, and turn **Allow agents and plugins built by external publishers** off.
5. Open **Sharing**. Set **Who can share agents with the organization** to **Specific users** and choose **Agent Makers - Approved**.
6. Open **User access**. Set **Who can access agents and plugins** to **Specific users or groups** and choose **Copilot Pilot - Sales**.
7. Open **Reports > Usage > Agents**. Declarative agents use instructions, knowledge, and skills in the Copilot orchestration model; custom engine agents bring a custom runtime. Agent Builder is a guided Copilot app authoring path, while Copilot Studio is a broader low-code environment for agents and workflows.
